The wellbeing services counties (regions) below the 80% participation target for breast cancer screening in 2024 are:

- City of Helsinki with 74.3% participation
- West Uusimaa with 76.1% participation

These are both below the national average of 81.6% (excluding Åland) and below the 80% target. North Ostrobothnia, by contrast, is above target with 85.6% participation [S1, S2].

# Evidence-Based Equity Gaps and Decision Support Candidates


## 1. Regional breast-screening participation gap — observed 2024

The Finnish Cancer Registry reports **81.6%** breast screening participation nationwide (excluding Åland), compared with **74.3% in the City of Helsinki**, **76.1% in West Uusimaa** and **85.6% in North Ostrobothnia**. The difference between these last two regional observations is **9.5 percentage points**.

**Repository:** AstraZeneca Junction 2026 | **Language:** English | **Coverage:** Cancer prevention, screening and selected cancer outcome statistics.
